metadata.agent_last_message:
The IGES 5.3 reader/writer/evaluator is complete and working. Summary:

**Project structure** (`output/`):
- `Cargo.toml` — package manifest with empty `[dependencies]`
- `src/main.rs` — CLI entry point
- `src/cli.rs` — subcommand dispatch
- `src/error.rs` — error/diagnostic types
- `src/json.rs` — minimal JSON encoder/decoder
- `src/model.rs` — top-level data model (Global, DE, etc.)
- `src/entities.rs` — 87 entity-data types with `to_json`/`from_json`
- `src/tokens.rs` — free-format tokenizer with Hollerith handling
- `src/parser.rs` — IGES file parser (sections + entity dispatch)
- `src/writer.rs` — IGES file writer (80-col fixed format)
- `src/eval.rs` — parametric eval for all 8 curve types and 11 surface types

**Features implemented**:
- All 5 subcommands (`parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`) with correct exit codes
- All 87 IGES 5.3 entity types in the catalog
- 80-col fixed-format ASCII output with proper section structure (S/G/D/P/T)
- Hollerith string encoding/decoding including line-spanning
- Free-format parsing with delimiter detection (forms 1-4)
- DE cross-reference validation (negative `view`/`xform_matrix`/`label_display`)
- Global field validation (positive `integer_bits`, `model_space_scale`, etc.)
- Form-dependent encoding for Plane/Cyl/Cone/Sph/Tor surfaces, Drawing, View, etc.
- Diagnostic JSON output with field-name substring for error identification
- Parametric eval with native-domain parameters and TM application
- Byte-stable roundtrip (fixed-point after one normalization pass)

editorial.last_message:
The IGES 5.3 reader/writer/evaluator is complete and working. Summary:

**Project structure** (`output/`):
- `Cargo.toml` — package manifest with empty `[dependencies]`
- `src/main.rs` — CLI entry point
- `src/cli.rs` — subcommand dispatch
- `src/error.rs` — error/diagnostic types
- `src/json.rs` — minimal JSON encoder/decoder
- `src/model.rs` — top-level data model (Global, DE, etc.)
- `src/entities.rs` — 87 entity-data types with `to_json`/`from_json`
- `src/tokens.rs` — free-format tokenizer with Hollerith handling
- `src/parser.rs` — IGES file parser (sections + entity dispatch)
- `src/writer.rs` — IGES file writer (80-col fixed format)
- `src/eval.rs` — parametric eval for all 8 curve types and 11 surface types

**Features implemented**:
- All 5 subcommands (`parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`) with correct exit codes
- All 87 IGES 5.3 entity types in the catalog
- 80-col fixed-format ASCII output with proper section structure (S/G/D/P/T)
- Hollerith string encoding/decoding including line-spanning
- Free-format parsing with delimiter detection (forms 1-4)
- DE cross-reference validation (negative `view`/`xform_matrix`/`label_display`)
- Global field validation (positive `integer_bits`, `model_space_scale`, etc.)
- Form-dependent encoding for Plane/Cyl/Cone/Sph/Tor surfaces, Drawing, View, etc.
- Diagnostic JSON output with field-name substring for error identification
- Parametric eval with native-domain parameters and TM application
- Byte-stable roundtrip (fixed-point after one normalization pass)
